title: Spend Filament — message-level attribution matrix & pricing composer
creator: Lina Park
description: Goal: design a compact, scannable UI surface for per-message spend attribution that lets customers trace a single API invocation to its pricing components, reassign attribution, and export a role-aware CSV for chargeback. The feature — Spend Filament — combines an interactive attribution matrix, a micro-lineage timeline, and a pricing-composer panel for scenario modeling (rate overrides, discounts, sku-splitting). This ticket covers the high-fidelity prototype, developer handoff assets, and the first usability round with two enterprise pilot customers.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive attribution matrix that expands a selected invocation to show token buckets, quantization adjustments, and routing costs
Export flow that produces a role-tagged CSV matching finance schema v2 (columns documented in PRD)
Pricing composer modal to apply hypothetical rate bands and show delta in estimated spend in real-time
Figma prototype links provided and annotated with component tokens and responsive rules
Design tokens and CSS variables specified for engineering; handoff checklist completed
Usability test notes incorporated and at least 80% of critical issues resolved before release
design_decisions: Prefer a compact matrix view (rows: invocations, cols: price components) to avoid deep drill flows; expands inline to preserve context
Use a separate Pricing Composer slide-over to keep attribution UI lightweight while still enabling scenario modeling
Show both absolute and normalized unit cost columns to satisfy finance and engineering audiences
Avoid embedding role-based filters directly in the matrix to reduce cognitive load; expose as persistent filter bar
Export schema should be stable for programmatic ingestion; include metadata (request_id, model_version, shard_key) on every row
